_doc: Media engine conformance (SPEC §7G). A port's harness starts a fake HTTP server, replaces "{server}" in style.baseUrl and in script[].headers values with its URL, sets case.env, then serves script[] in order (an entry's optional headers are sent as response headers): entry 0 answers the start request, entries 1.. answer polls; once exhausted the LAST entry repeats. Every request is recorded; path is recorded exactly as sent (percent-encoding NOT decoded). The harness calls generate(verb,args) and the tool face, and asserts: requests (method, path, body for start, header values in expectHeaders), progress statuses, and either result (MediaResult minus nothing) or error (exact message string). tool = the expected ToolResult (output, isError, parts, metadata). styleError:true marks a style that is invalid at load (SPEC §7G Empty dotPath): a port whose constructor/loader can fail may raise the same error message there instead of from generate; either way no request is made and there is no tool case. Poll timings in these styles are tiny so the suite runs in milliseconds. SINCE ADR 0037: the harness builds createMedia(styleMediaClient(style, case.config ?? {})) — style clients default to gather mode url, so URL results stay URLs; success tool metadata carries client ("style" unless style.name). status, when present, is the error's media status (failed|timeout|cancelled|unavailable). unsetEnv lists env vars removed for the case. modelParts (SPEC §7G.6 model visibility): the parts of this tool result that message assembly (§8A) emits to the model — only image parts; video/audio parts stay in RunResult.files and toolCalls[].parts only. Assert with the port's assembly function on a transcript containing this tool result. D9 (SPEC §7G.12): when modelParts is [] the tool-result content the port sends to the model is the plain output string in every message style incl. Anthropic — never an empty content array, never a placeholder; assert it with the same assembly function. D19: arg checks skip the style client like unavailable (reason '<name>: argument "<k>" not supported' / '<name>: missing required argument "<k>"', <name> = style.name ?? "style"), so a single style yields the joined 'media: no client available for …' error; a non-canonical key is the plain '<verb>: argument "<k>" not supported'. D23: expectHeaderPatterns = header name → regex that the header value must match on EVERY request.

cases.name: redirect_303_same_origin_post_becomes_get
cases.note: §7G Redirects: a same-origin redirect is followed and keeps the style headers; 301/302/303 after a non-GET/HEAD request is re-issued as GET with no body.

cases.name: redirect_307_keeps_method_and_body

cases.name: redirect_loop_too_many
cases.note: §7G Redirects: at most 10 redirects are followed (11 requests); the next redirect is the error <verb>: too many redirects.
